findings.title: deleteMany with retryCount > 1 is not scoped to SMS method, risking deletion of EMAIL/WHATSAPP reminders
findings.body: The second branch of the OR condition `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` has no `method` filter. This means any WorkflowReminder row (including EMAIL and WHATSAPP methods) with retryCount > 1 will be deleted by this cron job. While currently only SMS reminders have their retryCount incremented, this is fragile: any future code that touches retryCount on non-SMS reminders, or any data migration/bug that sets it, would cause silent deletion of email or WhatsApp reminders. The condition should include `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` to match the intent described in the PR.

findings.title: retryCount increment uses read-then-write pattern instead of atomic increment
findings.body: The code reads `reminder.retryCount` at query time and later writes `reminder.retryCount + 1`. If two cron executions overlap (e.g., due to scheduling delays or retries), both could read the same value and write the same incremented value, effectively losing a retry count. Using Prisma's atomic `{ increment: 1 }` operator instead of `reminder.retryCount + 1` would prevent this lost-update scenario. The same issue exists in the catch block at line 195.
